notes: Performance & stability release. Backend: language servers now shut down when their project closes (was leaking ~500MB rust-analyzer/pyright per project) and their stderr is drained so they can't deadlock; git status/overview/branches/log/file-at, diff, and the project-file walk all moved off the IPC worker pool so an fs storm in one repo no longer stalls terminal input; the fs watcher now ignores build/test/cache dirs (cargo/pytest/node runs stop firing cache-busting events); Rundeck config is mtime-cached instead of re-read every poll; Rundeck log/watch pollers back off exponentially on errors and give up instead of hammering an unreachable instance; AWS log tails and Rundeck handles self-prune on exit; idle background terminals reclaim scrollback memory after 10 min. Frontend: closing a project reaps its LSP servers; the git diff baseline only refetches on real git ops instead of every save; saving a file no longer triggers a re-read of every open tab.
